The Council of Industry is an association of more than 130 Hudson Valley manufacturers. Founded in 1910, our mission is to promote the success of our member firms and their employees and through them contribute to the success of the Hudson Valley community. The Council is a privately funded not-for-profit organization. We provide access to training, networking opportunities, advocacy, and discounts on products and services for our members and in partnership with our sister organization, the Hudson Valley Manufacturing Workforce Center, Workforce Development.
